notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello

I've uploaded a patch to the game fixing some issues with score uploads to the scoreboards. Sometimes scoreboards would not load properly, so scores could not be sent to the Steam scoreboards. Hopefully it should all work now and I apologize for the delay, I was not made aware of the issue until today. :)

Much joy challenging eachother. :)
